We welcome collaborators, especially researchers using AI in sciences beyond
climate and Earth system science, and anyone with an error story to share.

## Express interest

Write to us with a few lines about your work and how you'd like to be
involved:

<span class="email-obfuscate" data-user="ryan.oloughlin" data-domain="qc.cuny.edu">ryan.oloughlin [at] qc.cuny.edu</span>

## Share an error story

Tell us about a time an AI-driven model went wrong: what happened, how it was
found, and what it taught you. A few lines by email is plenty, and we'll
follow up.

<!-- Check with CUNY's IRB before using shared stories in research or on the
site (see README). -->
